{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
# D112 Step 2: CED 打分 + k=1 top 筛选
# NLI 模型用 cross-encoder/nli-deberta-v3-base（已在 HF cache）
# 用法：GPU=0 bash step2_ced_score.sh
set -e

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=${GPU:-${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES:-0}}
export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
cd /root/autodl-tmp

INPUT_DIR=/root/autodl-tmp/rsft_generations_4b_sft_s44
OUTPUT_DIR=/root/autodl-tmp/rsft_scored_4b_sft_s44
NLI_MODEL=cross-encoder/nli-deberta-v3-base

echo "=== D112 Step2: CED scoring + k=1 filtering on GPU $CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES ==="

python -m freige.training.rsft_score_filter \
  --input_dir "$INPUT_DIR" \
  --output_path "$OUTPUT_DIR" \
  --nli_model_path "$NLI_MODEL" \
  --nli_device "cuda:0" \
  --tau 0.5 \
  --format_weight 0.2 \
  --f1_weight 0.4 \
  --ced_weight 0.4 \
  --format_threshold 0.5 \
  --f1_threshold 0.1 \
  --ced_threshold 0.0 \
  --selection_strategy top_k \
  --top_k 1

echo "=== D112 Step2 complete. Output: $OUTPUT_DIR ==="
echo "Training data: $OUTPUT_DIR/rsft_train.jsonl"
echo "Report: $OUTPUT_DIR/rsft_report.json"
